$comment: SharedID Edge on Lambda@Edge: copy to edge.config.json, set your values, and run npm run bundle:edge -w @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda. The same SID_* settings as the regional function's environment variables (docs/configuration.md); SID_MODULE_CONFIG may be an object. Lambda@Edge has no environment variables, so these are baked into the bundle: keep edge.config.json out of version control if it holds SID_MODULE_SECRETS.
